name: hiveku
description: Operate a Hiveku account from Codex — the Hiveku MCP server (~1,000 tools for content, CRM, website projects, deploys, analytics, email, social, voice) plus the safe-work doctrine, deploy diagnostics and the edge firewall play. Set HIVEKU_TOKEN to your account key.

interface.shortDescription: Operate a Hiveku account from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the Hiveku platform: the hiveku MCP server (content, CRM, website projects, deploys, analytics, email, social, voice) authenticated per-account via HIVEKU_TOKEN, plus skills that carry Hiveku's safe-work doctrine (verify identity, you-are-not-the-only-writer, scratch/secrets hygiene, PM tasks + Owner update) and the deploy diagnosis recipe (deploy_doctor).
